map.融资租赁、车贷等额租金计算与还款明细: Finance lease, auto-loan equal-rent calculation and repayment schedule
map.每期租金 = V·i·(1+i)ⁿ / ((1+i)ⁿ − 1)（V 租赁物价值: Per-period rent = V·i·(1+i)ⁿ / ((1+i)ⁿ − 1) (V asset value, i period rate, n periods)
map.基于等额年金（融资租赁）公式：每期租金由租赁物价值、利率与期数计算；还款前期利息: Based on the equal-annuity (finance lease) formula: each period's rent from asset value, rate and periods; early periods have higher interest share, later higher principal share, for leasing and financing decisions.
map.每月还款金额固定，前期利息占比高、本金占比低，后期利息减少、本金增加。适合收入稳: The monthly payment is fixed; early periods have higher interest share and lower principal share; later interest falls and principal rises. Suited to stable income and those wanting even monthly pressure.
map.每月本金固定，利息逐月递减，前期还款压力大，后期逐渐减少。总利息支出比等额本息少: Fixed principal each month, interest declines monthly; early repayment pressure is high, later gradually less. Total interest is less than equal-installment.
map.每月只还利息，到期一次性归还本金。每月还款压力小，但期末需偿还大额本金。: Pay only interest monthly, repay principal in full at maturity. Low monthly pressure, but a large principal is due at the end.
map.每月租金 = [(本金 - 残值÷(1+月利率)^n) × 月利率 × (1+月: Monthly rent = [(principal − residual÷(1+monthly rate)^n) × monthly rate × (1+monthly rate)^n] ÷ [(1+monthly rate)^n - 1] + residual×monthly rate
map.融资租赁中常见的计算方式，租赁期满后承租人可选择支付残值购买租赁物，或退还给出租: A common finance-lease method: at lease end the lessee may pay the residual to buy the asset, or return it to the lessor. Higher residual → lower monthly rent.

map.租赁每期付款类似年金：P = PV×i/(1-(1+i)^-n)，PV 租赁物现: Lease per-period payment resembles an annuity: P = PV×i/(1-(1+i)^-n), PV asset present value, i period rate, n periods. With residual, the last period is the purchase-option price.
map.比较「租赁总付出现值」与「购买+持有成本+残值」；租赁省初期现金但长期总成本高，: Compare 'PV of total lease outlay' with 'purchase + holding cost + residual'; leasing saves initial cash but long-term total cost is higher, suited to tight cash flow or fast-iterating equipment.
map.融资租赁和经营租赁区别？: What is the difference between finance and operating lease?
map.融资租赁期长、近乎转移风险所有权（期满可低价买断），入资产负债表；经营租赁短期、: Finance lease is long-term, nearly transfers ownership risk (can buy out cheaply at end), on the balance sheet; operating lease is short-term, returnable, expensed. Tax and reporting differ.
map.租赁一定比买便宜吗？: Is leasing always cheaper than buying?
map.不一定。租赁把资金占用转为分期，但含资金成本与利润，总支出常高于一次性买；优势在: Not necessarily. Leasing turns capital occupation into installments but includes financing cost and profit, so total outlay often exceeds a one-time buy; its edge is keeping cash and flexible exit.
